sources.quote: In British Columbia, CleanBC and Better Homes heat pump rebates require a registered contractor, and the standard utility streams generally want Home Performance Contractor Network membership
sources.publisher: Better Homes BC (Province of British Columbia / CleanBC)
sources.title: Do I have to work with a Home Performance Contractor Network member to access rebates through the CleanBC Better Homes and Home Renovation Rebate Programs? - Better Homes BC
sources.evidence: You are required to work with a Home Performance Contractor Network member to access Heat Pump rebates from the CleanBC Better Homes and Home Renovation Rebate Programs. As of July 1, 2022, you need to hire a Home Performance Contractor Network (HPCN) member for your heat pump installation to be eligible for heat pump rebates.

sources.quote: the Oil to Heat Pump Affordability program stopped taking new applications in mid-2026
sources.title: Oil to Heat Pump Affordability program - Natural Resources Canada
sources.evidence: July 31, 2026, was the last day to apply to the Oil to Heat Pump Affordability program. Applications submitted before the deadline will continue to be processed. This program is currently transitioning to Environment and Climate Change Canada.

sources.quote: a business-level claim such as net zero or carbon neutral to be substantiated using an internationally recognized methodology
sources.title: Guide to the June 2024 amendments to the Competition Act
sources.evidence: Important amendments to the Competition Act became law on June 20, 2024, following Royal Assent of Bill C-59. Claims about the environmental benefits of a product must be supported by adequate and proper testing. Claims about the environmental benefits of a business or business activity must be based on adequate and proper substantiation in accordance with an internationally recognized methodology.

sources.quote: implied consent from an inquiry runs six months against a longer sales cycle
sources.title: From Canada’s Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL) Guidance on Implied Consent | CRTC
sources.evidence: Implied consent must be acquired within the two-year period immediately before the day on which the message was sent, or within the six-month period immediately before the day on which the message was sent, in the case of an inquiry. Implied consent may be valid for up to 2 years, or just 6 months in the case of inquiries or applications.

sources.quote: Ontario prohibits unsolicited door-to-door sales of HVAC equipment such as furnaces, air conditioners and water heaters and voids those contracts
sources.title: Door-to-door sales and home service contracts | ontario.ca
sources.evidence: Salespeople cannot come to your door uninvited to sell you restricted products like air conditioners, furnaces, and hot water heaters. If you sign a contract for a restricted product or service as a result of restricted door-to-door marketing or due to misleading marketing materials left at your home, the contract will be considered void and you can keep the goods or services without obligation.

sources.quote: itinerant merchants are barred from contracts for heating and air conditioning equipment, heat pumps and geothermal systems included
sources.publisher: Office de la protection du consommateur (Québec)
sources.title: Contracts prohibited by itinerant sale
sources.evidence: Contracts for heating or air conditioning appliances (air conditioners, heat pumps, furnaces, geothermal systems, etc.) are prohibited by itinerant sale, and itinerant merchants are not allowed to enter into or be involved in entering into such contracts, even on an incidental basis. If a contract is entered into despite the prohibition, the consumer has one year after the day the contract was signed by both parties to cancel it.

sources.quote: Quebec also requires a Regie du batiment licence holder to show that licence number in advertising
sources.title: Displaying your licence - Régie du bâtiment du Québec - RBQ
sources.evidence: Contractors must indicate their licence number on any type of advertising, including business cards. An RBQ licence number has 10 digits and must be indicated as follows: RBQ licence: XXXX-XXXX-XX. Contractors must also indicate their RBQ licence number on estimates, bids, contracts, account statements and invoices.
